summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, reporting the results of its annual general meeting (AGM). The meeting approved audited financial statements for 2024 and 2025, re-elected directors, and reappointed auditors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or management change occurred. The filing is a routine report of shareholder votes, not a special situation under event-driven criteria.
